tool_input.description: Start interactive rebase to reword commits

tool_input.command:
# Save the final state
git show HEAD:README.md > /tmp/final_readme.md

# Reset to before the WIP commits
git reset --hard 3836a23

# Re-apply each change with proper commit messages
echo "// wip 5" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: add test line 5 to README"

echo "// wip 6" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: add test line 6 to README"

echo "// wip 7" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: add test line 7 to README"

echo "// wip 8" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: add test line 8 to README"

echo "// last" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: add final marker to README"

# Verify we match the final state
echo "---Verifying final state:---"
git log --oneline -5

# Create a message mapping for the commits we want to fix
cat > /tmp/commit_msg_map.txt << 'EOF'
9dd66e9224981e337adcb80c1ccae712eaa43989 docs: add test line 5 to README
9caafc03f81d5d097fefe2ef09d3ae9cefaa152f docs: add test line 6 to README
67e4903191be05363689d34a08a31e6462758cab docs: add test line 7 to README
a2458c3b30c64fde4899cb9c4ee4d1109f3a62ce docs: add test line 8 to README
EOF

# Try git filter-branch with a message filter
git filter-branch --msg-filter 'cat /tmp/commit_msg_map.txt | grep "^$(git rev-parse HEAD)" | cut -d" " -f2- || cat' HEAD~4..HEAD 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Use filter-branch to rewrite commit messages

result:
